exposure: parental perception of child's weight status
cohort: 492 school children (246 overweight/obese children, and 246 normal weight control children aged 5-9 years) in Saudi Arabia
finding: Independent risk factors for childhood overweight and obesity included having an unemployed father, a father with overweight/obesity, incorrect parental perception of child's weight, cesarean delivery, limited active play, frequent snacking, and high screen time.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to be an independent risk factor for childhood obesity.
